brief: @buildthis.bisks.net An "interactive poem" site that slowly reveals deeper aspects of one author's heartfelt, literary book for a fake author with a completely pretentious bio and a preposterous book
note: built THE LAST HONEST MIRROR by Wendell Osric Crane, four books deep, none real: 9 tiny poems about a self-checkout machine — scan each one for marginalia that gets more true than pretentious as it goes.
